text.p: Zydeco Energy Inc said Tuesday it extended an exploration agreement with Cheniere Exploration Co Inc covering a seismic project in western Cameron Parish, La.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Zydeco said it gave Cheniere until July 31 to fund $1.5 million and August 8 to fund an additional $1.9 million to maintain Cheniere's 50 percent interest in the project.
The funding represent Cheniere's share of the project costs, it said.

If Cheniere elects to discontinue funding, or is unable to raise funds to pay for its full share, Zydeco will be unable to pay all of the costs. If needed, it would use a portion of the proceeds from a planned public offering of common shares in the third quarter to fund the project. If the offer fails, it may seek funds from another source -- either by borrowing against its interest in the project, or selling a stake in the project.
Cheniere has so far advanced $12 million of the $15.49 million already spent for the project, it said.
